races.paceDynamic: Purple Owl is listed as NON-RUNNER, removing the only confirmed front-runner from this 11-runner field. This creates a pace vacuum that prominent runners Miss Goldfire, Washington Singer, Royal Rhythm, Bradman, and Jamaicaine will need to fill, likely resulting in a more contested early pace than originally anticipated. With five hold-up horses (Hillsin, Bread And Butter, Herbygoesbananas, Marhaba Million, Mistress Fox) sitting off the pace, the race sets up as a tactical affair where the prominent runners may go too hard early trying to establish position. This pace shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalize on a potentially over-contested early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard early fighting for the lead without Purple Owl
scenarios.body: The five hold-up horses get the perfect setup as the pace collapses in the final half-mile. Fresh finishers can pick off tired leaders with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners takes a clear lead and dictates a steady pace
scenarios.body: Washington Singer or Miss Goldfire could steal a march by avoiding the early scrap and maintaining a sustainable rhythm. Their class advantage shows when the hold-up horses have too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running early creating a slow pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the handiest horses closest to the pace benefit most. Royal Rhythm and Bradman are best positioned to capitalize on a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so fast that even the hold-up horses struggle
scenarios.body: Only the freshest horse with the best finishing kick can win from an impossible position. Mistress Fox gets significant weight relief but may need everything to fall right.

watchPoints.text: Purple Owl is confirmed NON-RUNNER which completely changes the early pace dynamics
Washington Singer and Miss Goldfire may clash early for the lead with no natural front-runner
Hillsin returning from 115-day break but Alan Jones horses can be ready first time back
Bradman and Jamaicaine both have conditional jockeys claiming useful weight allowances
Royal Rhythm returning from 178-day absence for yard with poor recent strike-rate

races.paceDynamic: Flash Man and Tetsworth will set the pace from the start, with Flash Man looking the more determined front-runner based on recent form. Both leaders have shown they can sustain their effort, so expect a genuine gallop throughout rather than a sprint finish. The sustained nature of Fontwell's undulating track will test stamina reserves, particularly with Moscow Star and Mega Etoile likely to track the leaders closely. This honest pace strongly favours hold-up horses with finishing kicks, as the early pace will soften up the front-runners over this demanding two-mile trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace burns hot early with Flash Man and Tetsworth dueling.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will drain the leaders' reserves, allowing patient riders to pick off tired horses in the final furlong. La Cadalora and Cockney Cleopatra can unleash their finishing speed when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Moscow Star or Mega Etoile position perfectly behind the leaders.
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners will have the ideal position to strike turning for home, avoiding the early pace battle while staying close enough to pounce. They can exploit any weakening of the pace-setters without getting caught too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Flash Man gets an easier lead than expected with Tetsworth settling.
scenarios.body: The favorite pace-setter can control the tempo and have enough left to resist late challenges. Flash Man's recent win at this trip suggests he can handle the tactical demands if not pressured too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or multiple fallers disrupt the race.
scenarios.body: A horse with minimal winning chances gets a soft lead or benefits from others' misfortune in a slowly-run affair. The race becomes a lottery where class and ratings matter less than position and luck.

watchPoints.text: Flash Man and Tetsworth could go too fast early if both refuse to settle, burning out before the finish

races.paceDynamic: Anytrixwilldo and Boys Of Wexford will contest the early lead in this 11-runner handicap chase, with both confirmed front-runners likely to ensure a genuine gallop from the off. The substantial field includes several prominent racers like Land Girl's Luck, Ballyfinn and Valirann Gold who will track the leaders, while hold-up horses Drumheller and Gata Ban will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. With two natural leaders guaranteed to go forward and a competitive field behind them, this honest pace will create a searching test over the extended trip. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina reserves who can track the pace and strike late, rather than pure front-runners or hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set honest fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field but allow tracking horses to position perfectly for a late challenge. Horses like Land Girl's Luck and Ballyfinn with prominent styles can follow the pace and have the class to kick clear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can steal a march while the other falters or gets headed
scenarios.body: Boys Of Wexford has recent winning form and could dominate if getting first run, while Anytrixwilldo has the experience to dictate terms. The extended trip suits both if they can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early and the leaders tire significantly
scenarios.body: Gata Ban and Drumheller could benefit from a collapse up front, though they need everything to fall right. The strong pace would set up perfectly for their patient tactics over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too conservatively or one pulls up leaving no pace
scenarios.body: Without genuine pace the race becomes tactical and suits horses that can quicken rather than stay. This would completely change the complexion but seems unlikely given both leaders' natural styles.

watchPoints.text: Boys Of Wexford and Anytrixwilldo must both be monitored early as their pace battle could set up the entire race dynamic
Land Girl's Luck's positioning behind the leaders will be crucial as she has the class to win if getting the right trip
Valirann Gold's freshness advantage having run 15 days ago could be significant in a field where most have been off longer
Friends Don't Ask returning from 183-day break makes any market support or lack thereof a key indicator
The jumping of Drumheller and Gata Ban from the back needs watching as any mistakes will end their chances

races.paceDynamic: No Mean Feat is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate a sustainable tempo without pressure from the break. With eight hold-up horses behind him, this creates a tactical race where the pace will be manageable early before quickening from the final flight. The lack of pace pressure means No Mean Feat can control fractions, while the massed ranks of hold-up horses will face a traffic-laden finish as they all converge late. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter and any prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If No Mean Feat jumps cleanly and maintains his lead unchallenged
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace suits his stamina profile perfectly and he can kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still organising behind him. Eight horses trying to come from off the pace creates inevitable traffic problems in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and favours a strong finisher
scenarios.body: Answer That or Man Oh Man can unleash superior finishing kicks from their hold-up positions when the race opens up late. The class edge of these higher-rated horses tells when the race develops into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Carnage Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get bunched and blocked in the straight
scenarios.body: The lesser-fancied runners like Rapid Mission or Anthracite find cleaner runs while the market leaders are stuck behind faltering horses. This creates upset potential when racing room becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If No Mean Feat stops quickly and creates a muddling pace throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a messy, stop-start affair where any horse can win from any position. Form lines become less reliable and the race becomes a lottery finish between multiple hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: No Mean Feat's jumping under pressure - any mistake hands initiative to traffic-laden hold-up horses behind
Answer That and Man Oh Man getting prominent positions early to avoid the inevitable late traffic jam
How quickly the pace develops after the first flight - slower tempo increases upset chances
Jacquetta and Anthracite showing early signs of their documented finishing fade
Whether any hold-up horse can secure racing room down the inside rail in the straight

races.paceDynamic: Mersey Street is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a comfortable tempo without pressure, allowing him to dictate terms through the early stages. Four horses (I Shut That d'Or, Le Galli Bier, Alto Alto, Footloose Man) all want prominent positions behind the leader, creating congestion and potential traffic problems approaching 2-3 out when the race begins in earnest. The hold-up brigade (Begin The Luck, Known Warrior, Wellwillya, Majestic Moment) will need luck in running and gaps to appear late. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can secure clean positions early and avoid the scramble, while the lone leader gets an armchair ride until challenged.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Leader Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Mersey Street maintains his uncontested lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: The O'Neill runner gets a soft lead and kicks clear when the prominent pack get in each other's way. His 1W4P record on similar going and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Congestion Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners create serious interference 2-3 out
scenarios.body: Traffic problems eliminate several fancied runners as they bunch up behind the leader, allowing a hold-up horse with a clear run to sweep through late. The winner comes from deep with momentum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Clean Prominent Success
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner secures the ideal position without trouble
scenarios.body: A shrewd prominent horse avoids the congestion by positioning perfectly and tracks Mersey Street into a winning challenge. Superior class tells when getting first run on the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners collapse from over-racing
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable as prominent horses fight for position, setting up a hold-up specialist to collect them all late. A patient ride from the back proves optimal.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe bunching behind Mersey Street as I Shut That d'Or, Le Galli Bier, Alto Alto and Footloose Man converge approaching 2 out
Monitor if Mersey Street gets too comfortable up front and builds an unassailable lead while others struggle for position
Check whether Begin The Luck and Majestic Moment can secure clear runs when the pace lifts, as traffic could eliminate their chances
Observe if Footloose Man shows any rustiness after his 149-day absence when the serious racing begins
Watch for trouble in running when the prominent quartet try to challenge simultaneously, creating a wall of horses
